title: Synthetic RFP coverage review
criteria: Support exporting service-request records as CSV.
Retain audit records for seven years.
Support single sign-on and document the supported protocols.

evidence.text: PROD-1: The sample product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
PROD-2: The sample administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
PROD-3: The sample product brochure says the product is "enterprise-ready".
